setup.players: Four players (or five with one sitting out per deal). Play is anticlockwise. Teams are one vs three or two vs two, determined by bidding; in two vs two the bidder calls a tarok (usually XIX) and its holder becomes the declarer's partner.

rules.objective: Win majority of card points in tricks; bidder's side (one vs three or two vs two) aims to make contract. Bonuses for declared combinations and last trick with pagát.
rules.gameplay: 1. Deal: 12 cards each, 6 in talon. 2. Bidding determines teams (one vs three or two vs two); bidder often calls XIX for partner. 3. Play 12 tricks anticlockwise; follow suit, trump if void. 4. Count card points in tricks; bonuses for declared combinations and pagát last trick.
